answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops fake identities at the inlet. A newcomer posts 100 POA in escrow and names a referrer; the graph acts as a beacon, exposing any cluster sharing one referrer. Peers may dispute a suspect identity; if upheld, its escrow is slashed and the referrer loses 30 POA jointly. Forging 1,000 identities thus costs 100,000 POA locked plus 30,000 POA of referrer risk, and each fake hits its nadir when its escrow burns. An honest agent pays only one escrow and keeps earnings undiluted.
